description: Through a door marked STAFF that is never locked: the closed stack, which is two rooms' worth of shelving crammed into one and lit by a single bulb on a cord you move with you as you go. Everything in here is either too fragile to browse, too valuable to browse, or was put here in a temper and never brought back out. The floor is reinforced with steel plate under the boards and you can feel the change underfoot at the threshold.
name: Fine Print — The Closed Stack
